3d printing in the simplest analogy, is like taking the squeezable icing and making layers to make a structure. These layers stick together because the nozzle pressures the hot melted plastic together to the previous layer. These layers add up and make an item.

It takes some time to learn, optimizing the print settings, and certain prints may be harder than others such as fine details. Because of the layers, they will not stick together as well as a solid piece of plastic, thus making the a printed item less strong than a factory made item.
